questions.prompt_html: \text{设连续随机变量} \, x \text{ 的分布函数} \, F(x) = \begin{cases} 0, & \quad x < 0 \\ A x^{2}, & \quad 0 \leq x \leq 2, \\ 1, & \quad x > 2 \end{cases}. \text{其中} A \text{为待定常数，则有} P\{1 < x < 3\} = (\text{.})
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{先确定常数}A,\text{由分布函数}F(x) \text{的右连续性，有} \\&\lim_{x\rightarrow 2^{-}}F(x)=F(2)\Rightarrow 4A=1\Rightarrow A=\frac{1}{4}\,.\quad\\&\text{又点}x=1,\ x=3 \text{都是}F(x) \text{的连续点，故} \\&P\{1<x<3\}=F(3)-F(1)=1-\frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned} \text{某型号电子管，其寿命(以小时计)为一随机变量}X,，\text{概率密度}\ f(x)=\begin{cases} \dfrac{100}{x^{2}},\ x\geq 100 \\ \\ 0, \ \ \text{其它} \end{cases}, \text{则三个电子管使用}150 \text{小时都不需要更换的概率为}().\end{aligned}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} P\{X>150\}&=\int_{150}^{+\infty}f(x)dx=\int_{150}^{+\infty}\frac{100}{x^{2}}dx\\&=-\frac{100}{x}\int_{150}^{+\infty}f(x)dx=\frac{100}{150}=\frac{2}{3}. \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l}\text{设随机变量} \lambda \text{的概率密度函数为} f(x)=\begin{cases}3x^{2}, & 0<x<1 \\ 0, & \text{其它} \end{cases}, \text{若随机变量} Y \text{表示对} \lambda \text{的三次独立观察中事件}\\ \left\{X\leq \frac{2}{3}\right\} \text{出现的次数，} P(Y=0)=\left(\right). \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{对于随机变量}X\text{有}p=P\left(X\leq \frac{2}{3}\right)=\int_{0}^{2/3}3x^{2}dx=\frac{8}{27}\ ,\\&\text{对于随机变量}Y\text{，依题意有}Y\sim B(3,p)\text{，故}\\&P(Y=0)=C_{3}^{0}p^{0}(1-p)^{3}=\left(1-\frac{8}{27}\right)^{3}=\left(\frac{19}{27}\right)^{3}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设随机变量}X\text{的概率密度}f(x)=\begin{cases}2x,&0<x<1\\ 0,&\text{其它}\end{cases}.\ \text{令}Y\text{表示对}X\text{的3次独立重复观测中事件}\left\{X\leq\frac{1}{2}\right\}\text{发生的次数，则}P\{Y=2\}=()\ .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由随机变量}X\text{求得}P\{X\leq \frac{1}{2}\}=\int_{0}^{1/2}2xdx=\frac{1}{4}\,.\quad\\&\text{又}Y\text{服从二项分布}B(3,\frac{1}{4})\,,\,\text{故}\\&\quad P\{Y=2\}=C_{3}^{2}\times(\frac{1}{4})\times(\frac{3}{4})=\frac{9}{64}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{先求}X\text{的分布函数}F(x).\text{显然，当}x<0\text{时，}F(x)=0,\text{当}x\geq 0\text{时有}\\ & \qquad F(x)=\int_{0}^{x} \int_{0}^{\frac{t}{3}} t e^{-\frac{t}{3}}\,dt=1-\left(1+\frac{x}{3}\right)e^{-\frac{x}{3}}\\ & \text{故}F(x)=\begin{cases} 1-\left(1+\frac{x}{3}\right)e^{-\frac{x}{3}},x\geq 0\\ 0,\qquad x<0\end{cases},\text{所以} \\ & P\{X\geq 6\}=1-P\{X<6\}=1-P(X\leq 6)=1-F(6)=1-\left[1-\left(1+\frac{X}{3}\right)e^{-\frac{x}{3}}\right]_{x=6}=3e^{-2},\\ & P\{6<X\leq 9\}=F(9)-F(6)=(1-4e^{-3})-(1-3e^{-2})=3e^{-2}-4e^{-3},\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {若} k < 0, \text {则根据密度函数的定义有} \\ P \{X \geq k \} = \int_ {k} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) d x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) d x = \int_ {3} ^ {6} f (x) d x = \frac {1}{3} + \frac {2}{3} = 1 \neq \frac {2}{3}. \\ \text {故} k \geq 0, \text {当} 0 \leq k \leq 1 \text {时,由} \\ P \{X \geq k \} = \int_ {k} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) d x = \int_ {1} ^ {k} f (x) d x + \int_ {3} ^ {6} f (x) d x = \frac {1}{3} (1 - k) + \frac {2}{3} = \frac {2}{3}. \\ \text {即} k = 1. \\ \text {当} 1 \leq k \leq 3 \text {时,由题设} P \{X \geq k \} = \int_ {k} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) d x = \int_ {3} ^ {6} f (x) d x = \frac {2}{3}, \\ \text {即} 1 \leq k \leq 3 \text {时,结论成立}. \\ \text {当} 3 < k \leq 6 \text {时,有} P \{X \geq k \} = \int_ {k} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) d x = \int_ {k} ^ {6} f (x) d x = \frac {2}{9} (6 - k) < \frac {2}{3}. \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设随机变量}x\text{的概率密度为}f(x)=\begin{cases} kx^{b}, & \quad 0<x<1(b>0,k>0) \\ 0, & \quad \text{其它} \end{cases},\text{且}P\{\xi>1/2\}=0.75,\text{则}k=(\ \ ).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由概率密度的性质}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)dx=1,\text{有}\\&\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)dx=\int_{0}^{1}kx^{b}dx=1,\text{即}\ \frac{k}{b+1}=1.\\&\text{又}\ P\{\xi>1/2\}=1-P\{\xi\leq1/2\}=0.75,\\&\text{推出}\ P\{\xi\leq1/2\}=F(1/2)=\int_{0}^{1/2}kx^{b}dx=0.25,\text{得}\ (\frac{1}{2})^{b+1}=\frac{1}{4},\\&\text{即}\ b=1,\ \ k=2.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{概率密度的性质} \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x) dx = 1 \text{得} \\&\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x) dx = \int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2} A \cos x dx = 1 \Rightarrow A \sin x \Big|_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2} = 1 \,, \\&\text{即}\quad A = \frac{1}{2} \, . \\&\text{由连续随机变量分布函的性质得} \\&P\{0 < X < \frac{\pi}{4}\} = P\{0 < X \leq \frac{\pi}{4}\} = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \frac{1}{2} \cos x dx = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{4} \, .\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{由连续随机变量的概率求解式} P\{a < X \leq b\} = \int_{a}^{b} f(x) dx \text{得} \\& P\{X < 4\} = P\{X \leq 4\} = \int_{-\infty}^{1} f(x) dx = \int_{-\infty}^{2} 0 dx + \int_{2}^{1} \frac{1}{27} (1+x) dx = \frac{2}{27} (x + \frac{1}{2} x^2) \vert_{2}^{1} = \frac{16}{27} \ , \\& P\{3 < X < 4\} = P\{3 < X \leq 4\} = \int_{3}^{4} f(x) dx = \frac{2}{27} (x + \frac{1}{2} x^2) \vert_{1}^{4} = \frac{1}{3} \ . \end{aligned}
